verdict.rationale: Semgrep's automations are its custom rules and CI scan jobs. The evidence shows rules can be tested with annotated test code before rollout, which is a form of review (semgrep-docs-37). Rules can also be published as private org rules to the Registry (semgrep-docs-36), and scans run as CI jobs triggered by push/PR events (semgrep-docs-14, semgrep-docs-25). Nothing documents versioning, change history, or rollback of rules or scan policies, so the story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: documented rule/policy version history, review/approval workflow for rule changes, rollback of rules or scan configurations, independent corroboration.
